title: Nimble Korean Scallion Dosirak
description: A peppery, velvety scallion rice bowl finished with a dazzling flambe, perfect for a sattvic-friendly lunchbox.
instructions: Cook 200g of rice according to package instructions; set aside when fluffy.
In a small bowl whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, ginger, gochujang, and pinch of salt until fully blended.
Heat 3 tbsp sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add sliced scallions to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute until aromatic.
Add cubed tofu and cook for 3 minutes, turning until lightly browned on all sides.
Pour the prepared sauce over the tofu and scallions; cook for 2 minutes, letting the mixture reduce slightly.
Stir in the cooked rice, gently mixing until the rice is evenly coated with the sauce; cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Sprinkle 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds throughout the rice and stir to combine.
Remove the skillet from heat and transfer the rice mixture into a lunchbox, arranging the scallions on top.
If desired, poach an egg and place it atop the rice for added protein.
Drizzle 1 tbsp soju over the hot rice, allowing the alcohol to settle.
Ignite the soju gently with a long match, letting the flames subside before serving.
